meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Telegram 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Telegram 频道消息功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Telegram channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Telegram channel messaging to your application

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 Telegram 机器人收发消息。它会自动设置适配器和依赖，并引导你完成机器人和配对流程。
howto.when: 当你要求添加 Telegram 频道、接入代理或开始配对机器人时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加 Telegram 频道，我想用 Telegram 和你聊天。
say.note: 开始执行 Telegram 集成步骤。

say.text: 我要创建一个 Telegram 机器人并配对这个聊天。
say.note: 会出现4位配对码，发送给机器人即可。

say.text: 把我的 Telegram 账号和代理连接起来。
say.note: 需要先提供 bot token 并完成握手。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can send and receive messages through a Telegram bot. It sets up the adapter and dependencies, and guides you through bot creation and chat pairing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a Telegram channel, integrate with your agent, or start pairing a bot.

say_en.text: Add a Telegram channel so I can chat with you on Telegram.
Create a Telegram bot and pair this chat.
say_en.note: Shows a 4-digit code to send to the bot.

say_en.text: Connect my Telegram account to the agent.
say_en.note: Asks for the bot token and runs the handshake.
